newsitem.title: CANADA: CanWest to buy Westpac TV3 stake.
newsitem.headline: CanWest to buy Westpac TV3 stake.

text.p: CanWest Global Communications Corp said on Wednesday its unit agreed with New Zealand-based Westpac Communications Ltd to acquire Westpac's 50 percent equity interest in New Zealand's TV3 network for NZ$78.8 million, payable on September 2, 1997.
On completion of the acquisition, CanWest will own 68 percent of TV3 shares and hold options for the remaining 32 percent of TV3 shares. CanWest said it would acquire TV3 on April 1, 1997.
Westpac Communications is a subsidiary of Westpac Banking Corp.
CanWest said the acquisition of Westpac's interests in TV3, which comes after a five-year partnership, will have "a significantly positive impact" of CanWest's operating results in the future.

In a separate deal, TV3 is to redeem in full the NZ$74 million note issue it made in 1991, CanWest said. It said funds for the redemption are to be furnished by means of a NZ$51.2 million loan to TV3 from another of CanWest's subsidiaries and from a portion of TV3's cash reserves. Redemption of the notes will result in a NZ$14.8 million payment to CanWest.
